issues.text: Intended: Back preserves email; Contact returns with Acme but the previously entered email is blank.
Visible Contact/Attendee labels are not programmatically associated: controls surface as unnamed or placeholder-named.

Confirming the EARLY-discount registration opens a confirmation panel showing 2 attendees, 2 reserved seats, and the correctly discounted $148.50 total. — Alice Standard and Bob Student were added and seats set to 2 (steps 16-17); EARLY was applied with the visible 10%-off message (step 20), but clicking Confirm registration produced domChanged=NO and no confirmation panel was observed (step 20).

Submitting person@.example.com leaves the email unvalidated: no visible validation error appears near the profile fields, and the previous “Your changes have been saved.” confirmation remains visible.
Required-name error remains visible after the Full name field has been filled with “Jordan Lee”.

Submitting person@.example.com shows an email validation error and clears any prior saved confirmation. — After submitting the invalid address in step 10, step 11 observes person@.example.com with no error text and the prior saved confirmation still visible.

A final submission with person@.example.com is rejected with a visible validation error rather than proceeding as a save. — After the final invalid submission in step 18, step 19 freshly observes person@.example.com with no visible profile validation error.

Rapidly clicking Place order twice for first@example.com creates exactly one completed order and one receipt. — After changing the email to first@example.com in step 8, the subsequent Place order click was reported in step 9 as a repeated action with no page state change, and no processing, confirmation, or first@example.com receipt was observed before the run failed.
Clicking Send to stakeholders shows a browser alert saying "Report sent." — Step 2 directly clicked Send to stakeholders but recorded domChanged=NO and no resulting alert observation or dismissal.
Clicking Export CSV shows a browser alert saying "Export queued." — Step 3 directly clicked Export CSV but recorded domChanged=NO and no resulting alert observation or dismissal.
